Record Class Theme.Palette

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.taskflow.ui.Theme.Palette
Record Components:
bg - window background
surface - cards and dialogs
surfaceAlt - inputs and hover fills
border - thin outlines
text - main text
muted - secondary text
hint - placeholders and idle icons
accent - brand blue used for fills
accentText - brand blue used for text (lighter in dark mode)
onAccent - text drawn on top of the accent colour
danger - errors and high priority
success - completed tasks
warning - medium priority and "due today"
info - low priority
Enclosing class:
Theme
public static record Theme.Palette(Color bg, Color surface, Color surfaceAlt, Color border, Color text, Color muted, Color hint, Color accent, Color accentText, Color onAccent, Color danger, Color success, Color warning, Color info) extends Record

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:

      Returns:
